# The Heart by Ultrasound

> An illustrated, interactive guide to echocardiography: physics, standard views, hemodynamics, ventricular function, valve disease and structural heart procedures.

Each guideline value on this page is cited to its source. The cut-off values are taken from the American Society of Echocardiography (ASE), the European Association of Cardiovascular Imaging (EACVI), the British Society of Echocardiography (BSE), the ACC/AHA, the ESC and the ESC/ERS.

The figures are generated by simple models calibrated to agree with these sources. The diastolic values and the Doppler and strain values of the amyloid heart are illustrative and are not patient data. All images are simulated, including the drawings, the heart model and the echocardiographic views.

Each chapter opens by its key in the address, for example https://intro2echo.com/#pulse.

## Chapters

- [01 Pulse](https://intro2echo.com/#pulse): The pulse-echo principle
- [02 Image](https://intro2echo.com/#image): Image formation and artifacts
- [03 Doppler](https://intro2echo.com/#shift): The Doppler effect
- [04 Views](https://intro2echo.com/#windows): Acoustic windows and imaging planes
- [05 Cycle](https://intro2echo.com/#cycle): The cardiac cycle
- [06 Loop](https://intro2echo.com/#loop): LV pressure–volume analysis
- [07 Doppler hemodynamics](https://intro2echo.com/#pressure): Flow, pressure and the IVC
- [08 Systolic function](https://intro2echo.com/#eject): LV volumes, LVEF and strain
- [09 Diastolic function](https://intro2echo.com/#fill): Filling and LA pressure
- [10 Regional wall motion](https://intro2echo.com/#segments): The 17-segment model
- [11 Right ventricle](https://intro2echo.com/#rv): RV size and function, pressure and volume overload, acute pulmonary embolism
- [12 Aortic stenosis](https://intro2echo.com/#as): LV pressure load
- [13 Aortic regurgitation](https://intro2echo.com/#ar): LV volume and pressure load
- [14 Mitral stenosis](https://intro2echo.com/#ms): LV inflow obstruction
- [15 Mitral regurgitation](https://intro2echo.com/#mr): Left heart volume overload
- [16 Tricuspid regurgitation](https://intro2echo.com/#tr): Right heart volume overload
- [17 Transesophageal echocardiography](https://intro2echo.com/#tee): The probe, its movements and the standard views
- [18 Transcatheter aortic valve replacement](https://intro2echo.com/#tavr): TAVR, step by step: what TEE shows at each step
- [19 Mitral transcatheter edge-to-edge repair](https://intro2echo.com/#mteer): M-TEER, step by step: what TEE shows at each step
- [20 Tricuspid transcatheter edge-to-edge repair](https://intro2echo.com/#tteer): T-TEER, step by step: what TEE shows at each step
- [21 Diseases of the aorta](https://intro2echo.com/#aorta): Root size, aneurysm, dissection and coarctation
- [22 AI interpretation and measurement](https://intro2echo.com/#ai): EchoPrime and EchoNet-Measurements: views, weights, task heads and calipers

## Bonus chapters

- [B1 Stress echocardiography](https://intro2echo.com/#stress): Dobutamine stress, ischemia and viability
- [B2 Strain](https://intro2echo.com/#strain): Global longitudinal strain by speckle tracking, its patterns, and cardio-oncology
- [B3 Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy](https://intro2echo.com/#hcm): Septal hypertrophy, SAM and outflow obstruction
- [B4 Cardiac amyloidosis](https://intro2echo.com/#amyloid): Echocardiographic signs
- [B5 Pericardial disease](https://intro2echo.com/#peri): Effusion, tamponade and constriction
- [B6 Prosthetic valves](https://intro2echo.com/#prosthetic): Aortic prostheses: stenosis and mismatch
- [B7 Infective endocarditis](https://intro2echo.com/#endocarditis): Vegetations, leaflet perforation and the echocardiographic criteria
- [B8 Shunts: ASD, VSD and PFO](https://intro2echo.com/#shunts): Septal defects, Qp/Qs and the saline study
- [B9 Cardiac masses and thrombus](https://intro2echo.com/#masses): Left atrial myxoma, LV thrombus and papillary fibroelastoma
- [B10 Complications of myocardial infarction](https://intro2echo.com/#mi): Septal rupture, papillary muscle rupture, free-wall rupture and LV aneurysm
- [B11 Left ventricular assist devices](https://intro2echo.com/#lvad): The HeartMate 3: the surveillance study, the speed ramp and complications
